agentSettings.subtitle: Defaults for models, workspace, sampling, and how responses are shown.
agentSettings.sectionDesc: Changes are written to your gateway config file. Some values apply on the next agent turn or session.
agentSettings.needToken: Save a gateway token to load and change agent defaults.

routeIntro.workspace: Working directory for agent files and limits for inbound images in the image tool.
routeIntro.browser: Let the agent drive the web via browser_use. Enable tools, pick a connection method, then finish setup below.
routeIntro.runtime: Per-turn time limits, tool call depth, request retries, and consecutive tool failure caps.
routeIntro.context: Context compaction and tool-result pruning before messages reach the model.
routeIntro.memory: Memory snapshots, session_search summary model, and optional background review.
routeIntro.tools: Optional tools (web_extract, delegate_task, execute_code), global built-in tool access, and extension params JSON. Available skills are under Skills.
routeIntro.skills: Skills marketplace source (use the section Save button) and default available skills for all agents (use the page header Save). Install skills in the Skills library. Per-tool toggles are under Tools.
routeIntro.systemPrompt: Optional prompt customization for the selected agent profile.
routeIntro.modelStrategy: Model roles and default role selection for agent settings.
routeIntro.generation: Control response length, randomness, thinking level, reasoning visibility, and verbosity.

agentSettings.browserPlaywrightGuideDesc: When Local (Playwright) is selected, Chromium must be installed on the gateway host. You can install it here or run the install command manually on that machine.
agentSettings.browserCloakGuideDesc: CloakBrowser provides anti-fingerprint Chromium. After saving, the gateway uses it from this config; you can also run the install command first to download it.
agentSettings.browserCloakProfileAgentHint: Uses the profile from saved config — same as agent runtime. Save settings after changing paths or profile options.
agentSettings.browserCloakTemporaryProfileHint: Temporary profile enabled — each launch uses a new profile
agentSettings.browserCloakTemporaryProfileOn: Use a temporary profile each time
agentSettings.browserHumanizeOn: Simulate more natural mouse, keyboard, and scroll input

agentSettings.browserModeCdpTagline: Drive a local debuggable Chrome over CDP
agentSettings.browserModeExtTagline: Bridge a real user's Chrome via extension
agentSettings.browserDisabledHint: Enable browser tools to choose a connection method and configure the backend.
agentSettings.browserSetupSubtitle: Pick a connection method — you can change it anytime after enabling browser tools.
agentSettings.browserSetupExtDesc: Bridge your everyday Chrome. Best for sites that need a logged-in session.
agentSettings.browserSetupLocalDesc: Headless or visible Chromium on the gateway host. Install once, then save.
agentSettings.browserSetupCloudDesc: Browserbase or Browser Use — no local Chromium install required.
agentSettings.browserWorkspaceExtSubtitle: Install the extension, start the bridge, and connect from Chrome.

agentSettings.browserWorkspaceCloakSubtitle: Download CloakBrowser and tune anti-fingerprint options.
agentSettings.browserWorkspaceCdpSubtitle: Launch or attach to a debuggable Chrome over CDP.
agentSettings.browserWorkspaceCloudSubtitle: Connect to Browserbase or Browser Use with your API credentials.
agentSettings.browserBehaviorHint: Headless mode and JavaScript dialog handling for all backends.
agentSettings.browserSecurityHint: Private URL access and per-command timeouts. Cloud metadata endpoints are always blocked.

agentSettings.browserConfirmDownloadBody: About to download CloakBrowser {{version}} for {{platform}} from {{url}}. The file will be SHA-256 verified before extraction.
agentSettings.browserCloakSha256Skipped: Manifest has no SHA-256 for this platform — integrity will NOT be verified.
agentSettings.browserCloakAdvancedHint: Binary cache, custom executable, timezone/locale emulation, WebRTC IP, and extra Chromium flags.
agentSettings.browserCdpLaunchLocalDesc: Spawns Chrome with --remote-debugging-port so the agent can drive it. The window stays open until you click Stop.
agentSettings.browserCdpLaunchedAtPort: Launched on port {{port}} — endpoint filled in below.
agentSettings.browserCdpLoopbackOnly: Only loopback endpoints (127.0.0.1 / localhost / ::1) are allowed for safety.
agentSettings.browserCdpChromePathDesc: Optional override. Empty uses Playwright Chromium first, then the system Chrome/Chromium.
agentSettings.browserBinaryPathWarning: ⚠ The gateway will execute the binary at this path with its own privileges. Only point to binaries you trust.
agentSettings.browserCacheDirHomeOnly: Must be under your home directory (e.g. ~/.xopc/bin).
agentSettings.browserExtensionDownloadHint: Load the xopc extension in Chrome and bridge to the gateway over WebSocket.
agentSettings.browserExtensionPathCopyFailed: Could not copy the path. Select the path and copy it manually.
agentSettings.browserExtensionNeedsChromeReload: xopc updated the extension on disk. Open chrome://extensions and click Reload on the xopc extension.
agentSettings.browserExtensionInstallStep1: Click Install locally above to copy the extension to your machine.
agentSettings.browserExtensionInstallStep2: Open the browser extensions page (Chrome or Edge) → turn on Developer mode → Load unpacked → select the folder below.
agentSettings.browserExtensionInstallStep3: Click Start bridge, then Connect in the xopc extension popup from the browser toolbar.
agentSettings.browserExtensionPortConflict: Port {{port}} is already in use. If this gateway owns the bridge, click Stop bridge; otherwise change the port or stop the process using it.
agentSettings.browserExtensionStartHint: Start the WebSocket bridge now so you can pair the extension before saving. The bridge will keep running until you click Stop.
agentSettings.cardGenerationSubtitle: Token budget, randomness, and tool loop depth

desc.modelFallbacks: Tried in order when the primary model returns an error after transient retries. Requires API keys for each provider.
desc.typedModels: Named model roles for workflows or internal tasks, such as small, large, and vision.
desc.smallModel: Optional cheaper/faster tier for lightweight workflow steps. Leave blank to fall back to the primary model.
desc.smallModelFallbacks: Tried in order when the small primary fails. Requires API keys for each provider.
desc.imageModel: Optional. Used for image understanding / vision. Only models the gateway marks as accepting image input are listed.
desc.imageModelFallbacks: Tried in order when the primary vision model fails. Only models flagged as image-capable are listed.
desc.imageGenerationModel: Optional. For image_generate. Only providers the gateway reports as configured (API keys present) are listed.
desc.imageGenerationModelFallbacks: Tried in order when the primary image generation model fails. Only configured image-generation providers are listed.
desc.mediaMaxMb: Max size when loading images in the image tool.
desc.browserEnabled: Exposes browser_use automation to the model (which browser runs depends on Backend mode below).
desc.browserHeadless: Default off: Chromium shows a window on the gateway machine. Turn on to run without a visible window (background).
desc.browserAllowPrivateUrls: Skip private-IP blocking for navigation. Cloud metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254, etc.) are always blocked regardless.
desc.browserCommandTimeout: Max seconds per browser command (navigate, click, etc.). Default 30.
desc.browserBackend: Connection mode: Local Playwright, direct CDP, cloud provider, or Chrome Extension bridge.
desc.browserCloudProvider: Cloud provider: Browserbase or Browser Use. You can set the API key here; environment variables BROWSERBASE_API_KEY / BROWSER_USE_API_KEY are still supported.
desc.browserCloudApiKey: Stored in gateway config. Leave empty to use process environment variables. Saved keys are masked on reload.
desc.browserCloudProjectId: Optional Browserbase project ID. Empty uses BROWSERBASE_PROJECT_ID or the provider default.
desc.browserCloudRegion: Optional. Passed to providers that support regions; empty uses the default region.
desc.browserCdpUrl: Direct Chrome DevTools Protocol WebSocket endpoint (e.g. ws://localhost:9222). Only used when backend is CDP.
desc.browserExtensionPort: WebSocket port for the Chrome Extension bridge. Default 19820.
desc.browserExtensionHost: Host for the Chrome Extension bridge. Default 127.0.0.1.
desc.browserExtensionConnectionTimeout: How long the gateway waits for the extension to connect (seconds). Default 30.
desc.browserCloakKeepOpen: Reuse one CloakBrowser process to reduce startup time for later tasks. Enabled by default.
desc.browserCloakTemporaryProfile: Use a temporary user-data directory on each launch and clean it up on close. Useful for isolated testing.
desc.browserCloakCacheDir: Optional. CloakBrowser home directory (binaries and profiles). Empty uses ~/.xopc/bin/cloakbrowser.
desc.browserCloakBinaryPath: Optional. Path to an existing CloakBrowser/Chromium executable, usually under ~/.xopc/bin. Set this to skip auto-download.
desc.browserCloakTimezone: Optional timezone to emulate (IANA name, e.g. America/New_York).
desc.browserCloakWebrtcIp: Optional public IP for WebRTC leak prevention.
desc.browserCloakFingerprintPlatform: Optional platform string for fingerprint emulation (e.g. windows, macos).
desc.browserCloakExtraArgs: One Chromium flag per line. Args with the same --key= prefix override defaults.
desc.browserHumanize: Use Bezier mouse movement, per-character typing, and natural scroll pacing to reduce automation signals.
desc.browserHumanPreset: Choose the input pace. Careful is slower but closer to real user behavior.
desc.browserDialogPolicy: How JS dialogs (alert/confirm/prompt) are handled: agent must respond, auto dismiss, or auto accept.
desc.browserDialogTimeout: Seconds before an unhandled dialog is auto-dismissed/accepted (only for auto policies). Default 300.
desc.maxTokens: Maximum tokens in the model response.
desc.maxToolIterations: Maximum tool calls per user message.
desc.thinkingDefault: Default thinking level for new sessions.
desc.reasoningDefault: Whether to surface model reasoning in the chat UI. Per-session overrides (e.g. /reasoning) take precedence until cleared.
desc.verboseDefault: Agent verbosity for logs/tool detail elsewhere — not the reasoning/thinking panel. Use Reasoning visibility to hide reasoning.

agentSettings.typedModelsInvalidId: Each model role needs a valid id (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, underscores).
agentSettings.typedModelsInvalidModel: Each model role needs a provider/model ref.
agentSettings.visionRegistryEmpty: No models flagged as image-capable for your configured providers. Add `input` including "image" in models.json, or pick a provider model that exposes image input.
agentSettings.visionOutOfFilterNote: Registry does not mark this model as image-capable; choose a vision model when possible.
agentSettings.imageGenRegistryEmpty: No image generation providers are configured with API credentials. Add keys for a provider (e.g. OpenAI) in config or environment, then refresh.
agentSettings.imageGenOutOfFilterNote: This model’s provider is not configured with credentials; image_generate will fail until you configure it or pick a configured provider.

advanced.cardLimitsSubtitle: Wall-clock cap per user turn, request retries, and tool failure budget.
advanced.maxTaskDurationMsDesc: Per-user-turn wall time for LLM and tools. Leave empty to use the server default. Range 1–240 min (1 min–4 h).
advanced.maxRequestsPerTurnDesc: LLM request attempts per user message (reliability; default 50).
advanced.maxToolFailuresPerTurnDesc: Consecutive tool errors before giving up (default 3).
advanced.goalsCheckLinkHint: Checklist judging defaults are configured under Settings → Automation → Goal runtime rules.
advanced.cardCompactionSubtitle: When to compact older context to stay within the model window.
advanced.compactionEnabledDesc: When off, the runtime skips compaction (may use more context).
advanced.compactionModeDesc: default: standard strategy; safeguard: stricter heuristics when enabled.
advanced.triggerThresholdDesc: Fraction of context that triggers compaction (0.5–0.95).
advanced.minMessagesBeforeCompactDesc: Message count before compaction can run (default 10).
advanced.keepRecentMessagesDesc: Recent turns always kept near the tail (default 5).
advanced.evictionWindowDesc: Portion of history eligible for summary-first eviction (0.1–0.5).
advanced.retentionWindowDesc: Recent turns in the retention band (3–20).
advanced.cardPruningSubtitle: Trim oversized tool results before the model sees them.
advanced.pruningEnabledDesc: When off, full tool output may be sent to the model (higher cost).
advanced.maxToolResultCharsDesc: Default cap for a single tool result string (default 10000).
advanced.headKeepRatioDesc: Fraction kept from the start when pruning (0–1, default 0.3).
advanced.tailKeepRatioDesc: Fraction kept from the end (0–1, default 0.3).
advanced.cardMemorySubtitle: Agent notes, global user memory, and optional provider hooks.
advanced.memoryEnabledDesc: Master switch: curated memory snapshot, tool, and external prefetch (when set).
advanced.useEnhancedSystemDesc: When off, use profile Markdown in the workspace only (no extra memory snapshot in system).
advanced.userProfileEnabledDesc: Add global user/MEMORY.md to the memory snapshot when present.
advanced.memoryProviderDesc: none/stub, or leave unset to omit.
advanced.injectionFrequencyDesc: How often to inject prefetched memory into the user message context.
advanced.memoryCharLimitDesc: Max chars for the curated memory snapshot (optional).
advanced.userCharLimitDesc: Max chars for the global user memory section (optional).
advanced.contextCadenceDesc: When using every turn: inject on turns 1, 1+N, … (min 1).
advanced.dialecticCadenceDesc: Reserved; not yet wired. Min 1 when set.
advanced.cardSessionSearchSubtitle: Model used to summarize past sessions for the session_search tool.
advanced.sessionSearchSummaryModelDesc: e.g. openai/gpt-4o-mini. Leave empty to use runtime defaults.
advanced.cardWebExtractSubtitle: Optional model and length for markdown web extraction.
advanced.webExtractModelDesc: Leave empty to use the default provider/model for extraction.
advanced.delegateEnabledDesc: When on, the agent may delegate to sub-agent runs (if supported).
advanced.executeCodeEnabledDesc: When on, the sandboxed code tool is available (if the runtime allows).
advanced.cardSystemPromptSubtitle: Optional override of the default system context. Merged with per-agent values; entry-specific settings win.
advanced.cardSkillsSubtitle: When non-empty, only these skills appear in <available_skills> in the prompt.
advanced.systemPromptOverrideDesc: Optional full replacement; merged with per-agent entry (entry wins). Leave empty to clear.
advanced.skillsAllowlistDesc: Only checked skills appear in <available_skills>. Leave empty for a clean default context; shared settings can declare their own visible skills.
advanced.cardToolsDisableSubtitle: Control built-in tool access for agent settings or shared settings (e.g. exec_command, web_search).
advanced.toolsDisableHint: Checked tools are available to the default agent; unchecked tools are blocked. Per-agent overrides in Agents still apply.
advanced.toolsDisableEmptyBuiltin: No built-in tools returned by the gateway.
advanced.cardParamsSubtitle: Opaque key/value for extensions. Must be a JSON object.
advanced.paramsJsonDesc: e.g. {"myFlag": true}. Clear to remove params from the config file.
advanced.paramsInvalidJson: Params must be valid JSON object (e.g. empty or {}). Check syntax.

memoryPanel.title: Memory
memoryPanel.subtitle: Local records, provider capabilities, recall signals, and provider traces.
memoryPanel.inboxHint: Review candidate memories before they become active recall context.
memoryPanel.understandingQualityHint: How inferred user understanding moves from candidate review into useful recall over the last 30 days.
memoryPanel.understandingQualityUnavailable: Understanding quality is not available yet.
memoryPanel.crossAgentDenyHelp: Only this agent can recall these structured memories.
memoryPanel.crossAgentReadOnlyHelp: Other participating agents can recall non-sensitive, unscoped memories. They cannot submit changes.
memoryPanel.crossAgentAllowHelp: Other participating agents can recall memories and, when both agents allow it, submit candidates for your review. Active memory is never changed directly.

agentsSettings.selectAgentHint: Choose an entry to edit. Profile Markdown (SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, …) is read from that agent's `agents/<id>/profile/` directory.
agentsSettings.editAgentHint: Updates agents.list on the gateway. Paths are expanded (~ → home).
agentsSettings.capabilityPresetsHint: The global baseline is applied first. Additional plans are applied in order, followed by this agent's own settings.
agentsSettings.capabilityPresetsGlobalDefaultHint: Applied to every agent before additional plans and the agent's own settings.
agentsSettings.capabilityPresetsEmpty: This agent does not use any additional capability plans.
agentsSettings.capabilityPresetsEmptyAdditional: No additional plans. The global baseline still applies.
agentsSettings.createCapabilityPlansHint: Optional. The global baseline is always included; choose any additional plans this agent should use.

inheritance.title: Configuration sources
inheritance.subtitle: See whether key runtime fields come from shared settings or this agent's own settings.

agentsSettings.agentDescriptionPlaceholder: Short summary shown on agent cards and in pickers (optional).
agentsSettings.modelSmallHint: Optional cheaper/faster tier for lightweight workflow steps. Leave blank to use shared model roles.
agentsSettings.addAgentHint: Same as CLI agents add: creates directories and seeds profile Markdown templates.
agentsSettings.newAgentIdPlaceholder: Leave empty to derive from display name
agentsSettings.newAgentIdRules: 1–64 characters: letters, digits, underscores, hyphens; must start with a letter or digit. Avoid reserved ids (e.g. main, con).
agentsSettings.filesHint: Editable persona files (SOUL, IDENTITY, …). Changes save automatically after you stop typing; use Preview to render Markdown.
agentsSettings.confirmDelete: Remove this agent from config? Bindings referencing it will be stripped.
agentsSettings.confirmDeletePurge: Remove this agent and delete its workspace + ~/.xopc/agents/<id> data? This cannot be undone.
agentsSettings.purgeConfirmLabel: Type the agent id to confirm
agentsSettings.purgeConfirmHint: This action is irreversible. Enter {{agentId}} exactly to enable deletion.
agentsSettings.toolsHint: Tool access for this agent. Tools blocked by shared settings cannot be re-enabled here.

toolDescriptions.code_search: Search indexed symbols, definitions, implementations, routes, and types.
toolDescriptions.code_read_symbol: Read exact source for a symbol returned by code search.
toolDescriptions.code_trace: Trace callers, callees, data flow, and cross-service paths.
toolDescriptions.code_impact: Map git changes to affected symbols and blast radius.
toolDescriptions.code_architecture: Summarize packages, boundaries, layers, entry points, hotspots, and clusters.
toolDescriptions.read_file: Read text and small files inside the agent workspace (paths are restricted to the workspace sandbox).
toolDescriptions.write_file: Create new files or overwrite existing ones under the workspace.
toolDescriptions.apply_patch: Apply strict multi-file patches for focused source changes.
toolDescriptions.list_dir: List files and subfolders in a workspace directory.
toolDescriptions.grep: Search file contents with regular expressions (similar to ripgrep).
toolDescriptions.find: Find files by name or glob pattern under the workspace.
toolDescriptions.exec_command: Run commands with workspace context; high impact, so disable for read-only or safer agents.
toolDescriptions.update_plan: Update the visible multi-step coding plan for the current turn.
toolDescriptions.web_search: Search the public web for facts and pages newer than the model may know.
toolDescriptions.web_fetch: Fetch a URL and read its text content for the model.
toolDescriptions.browser_use: Unified browser automation tool for navigation, snapshots, clicks, typing, screenshots, and browser pipelines.
toolDescriptions.send_message: Send outbound chat messages on connected channels (e.g. Telegram, CLI, gateway) when the agent replies.
toolDescriptions.send_media: Send images or other media attachments through those channels.
toolDescriptions.memory_search: Search indexed memories and notes stored for this agent.
toolDescriptions.memory_get: Load a specific memory entry or chunk by id.
toolDescriptions.curated_memory: Read or update curated markdown memories under the agent home directory.
toolDescriptions.session_search: Search across saved conversation transcripts and per-session summaries.
toolDescriptions.image: Analyze or describe images (vision) from the workspace or the current turn.
toolDescriptions.image_generate: Generate images using the configured image / image-generation model.
toolDescriptions.extensions: Expose tools registered by enabled extensions — disable to block all extension tools.
toolDescriptions.bundle-mcp: Load tools from configured MCP servers (global mcp.servers and extension .mcp.json).

agentsSettings.skillsHint: These skills appear in this agent's Chat / menu and <available_skills>. Other skills are hidden from the agent. Inherit uses shared settings; customize sets this agent's skills.

agentsSettings.typedModelVisionAutoHint: When no manual image understanding model is set, this image-capable role can be selected automatically at runtime.

typedModelRoleDescriptions.deep: Complex reasoning, planning, and long-context work.
typedModelRoleDescriptions.fast: Short replies, lightweight decisions, and low-latency tasks.
typedModelRoleDescriptions.cheap: Batch work, summaries, and cost-sensitive tasks.
typedModelRoleDescriptions.code: Code understanding, edits, tests, and architecture analysis.
typedModelRoleDescriptions.review: Reviews, risk checks, and second-pass validation.
